interface.title: Neurosift (v2)
interface.field: Neurophysiology / systems neuroscience (extracellular ephys, single units, two-photon imaging, behaviour), using NWB files on the DANDI Archive
interface.stage_of_work: Finding and looking at shared data: picking a dataset from a public archive, checking what a file contains, looking at it, and getting code to load it for analysis
interface.what_it_is_for: A browser viewer that searches the DANDI Archive and also lists OpenNeuro datasets (an EMBER Archive browser link was seen but not opened). It opens an NWB file straight from cloud storage without downloading it and shows its metadata, object tree, spike rasters, PSTHs, imaging summary images and ROI masks, with Python snippets that load the same data. Opening a local file or a file by URL was not tried in this run.

data.note: No uploads. Public DANDI data streamed live: dandiset 000004 (human MTL single units, file sub-P10HMH_ses-20060901_ecephys+image.nwb, 69.77 MB, 38 units, 200 trials) and dandiset 001876 (two-photon voltage imaging plus behaviour, sub-30270 ...obj-k3qgxc_behavior+ophys.nwb, 7.51 MB). Files loaded 'Using LINDI'. API key fields in Settings were left blank.

features.name: Three-mode dataset search (keyword / semantic / data-type facet)
features.general: Find datasets in a repository by keyword, by a plain-language description, or by the kinds of data objects their files contain, with a count of matching files per dataset
features.specific: DANDI Archive Browser: Basic Search, Semantic Search, or Neurodata Types Search (multi-select of NWB types such as Units) showing an 'N matching' badge on each dandiset card
steps: Choose a search mode radio
Type a query, or pick one or more neurodata types from the dropdown
Read the result cards (ID, dates, contact, files, size, N matching)
Click a card to open the dandiset
serves_tasks: Search the archive with a natural-language description
Filter datasets by the kinds of data objects their files contain

features.name: Dataset asset tree with file-type filter
features.general: Browse a dataset's files grouped by subject folder, optionally showing only one file type, and open a file in the viewer
features.specific: Dandiset page: version dropdown, description, a collapsible sub-* folder tree with sizes, copy and download icons, 'Show NWB files only', and a click to open the NWB viewer
steps: Optionally tick Show NWB files only
Expand a subject folder
Read file sizes
Click an .nwb file to open it in the viewer
serves_tasks: Look at a dataset's description and file listing
Open a single recording file in the viewer

features.name: Recording metadata overview panel
features.general: See who recorded a file and what session it is (lab, institution, session description, identifier, keywords, format version) as soon as the file opens
features.specific: NWB viewer OVERVIEW panel: Lab, Institution, Session description, Identifier, keywords, NWB Version, and a 'Using LINDI' load indicator
steps: Open an NWB asset from the dandiset page
Read lab, institution and session description
Read the identifier, keywords and NWB version
serves_tasks: Read the session and subject metadata

features.name: Object table with per-type viewers and multi-select stacking
features.general: List every data object in a file with its type, open a suitable viewer for one in its own tab, or tick several and view them stacked together
features.specific: Widgets tab: NWB object table (name, neurodata type, description), open-tab icon, view checkboxes (Raster, Figpack Raster, PSTH, Event Related Signal, Video Preview, XY), 'View N selected' opening a combined '2 items' tab, and a tab bar with a shareable URL
steps: Expand groups in the object table
Click a view label (e.g. Raster, PSTH) or the open-tab icon to open a viewer tab
Or tick several objects and press View N selected
Switch between or close tabs; copy the tab URL with the share button
serves_tasks: List the data objects in the file with their types
Look at several data streams side by side on one time axis

features.name: Linked time-window navigator for event rasters
features.general: Scroll through long recordings in a time window you can zoom and pan, page through many channels, and keep several stacked plots on the same time range
features.specific: Raster widget: 'Time Window Xs at Ts' readout, zoom in and out, ← → pan, drag to pan, Units −/+ and ↓/↑ paging; in a combined multi-item tab, zooming the top panel was seen once to move the other panel's window too (screens/044)
steps: Open a raster
Zoom in or out with the magnifier buttons
Pan with the arrows or by dragging across the plot
Add or page units with + / − / ↓ / ↑
In a combined tab, check the other panels' Time Window readout follows
serves_tasks: View spike trains of many cells over time
Look at several data streams side by side on one time axis

features.name: Event-aligned raster + PSTH with trial grouping
features.general: Line up each cell's spikes to repeated task events, colour trials by an experimental condition, and compare average firing rates, with the settings saved in the URL
features.specific: PSTH view on intervals/trials and units: Units checklist with spike counts, Align to columns (start_time, stim_on_time ...), Window range, Group trials by (e.g. new_old_labels_recog) with a Categories filter, Sort units by, Show raster/histogram, Num. bins, Smoothed, Height
steps: Tick one or more units
Tick one or more Align to events
Choose Group trials by and untick unwanted categories
Set the window range and number of bins, and tick Smoothed if wanted
Read the per-unit raster and firing-rate panels (state kept in the URL hash)
serves_tasks: Average a cell's firing around repeated task events, split by trial condition

features.name: Image-mask (ROI) viewer with orientation toggles
features.general: Show segmented regions as coloured masks next to their table, and flip or transpose the display to match other images
features.specific: PlaneSegmentation widget: table of ROIs (id, image_mask, mask_type) with a download icon, a mask canvas with one colour per ROI, xy swap / x flip / y flip checkboxes, and a 'Loaded N regions' count
steps: Open a PlaneSegmentation
Read the ROI table
Look at the coloured masks
Toggle xy swap, x flip or y flip to reorient
serves_tasks: View the outlines of segmented cells or regions

features.name: Summary image panel with display-range sliders
features.general: Show the 2-D summary images of an imaging session as thumbnails and adjust each image's brightness range with a two-handle slider
features.specific: Images widget for SummaryImages_* (average and correlation) with a min/max range slider per image
steps: Open an Images object
Look at the thumbnails
Drag the lower or upper slider handle to change the contrast
serves_tasks: View summary images from an imaging session and adjust their contrast

features.name: Raw HDF5 hierarchy inspector
features.general: Walk the raw file hierarchy and see each array's type, shape, chunking, compression, attributes and values
features.specific: HDF5 tab: expandable groups with item counts, datasets with dtype/shape/chunks/compressor, and attributes such as neurodata_type and namespace
steps: Press HDF5
Expand a group
Expand a dataset to see its metadata and values
serves_tasks: Browse the raw file hierarchy and inspect a dataset's values

features.name: Code generator for the file and for each object
features.general: Produce ready-to-run code that loads the same remote file, or just the object on screen, so a script can pick up where the viewer stopped
features.specific: Python Usage tab with Copy Script (PyNWB + LINDI loader listing every object, its shape and description), plus '+ Load in Python' under each widget showing lindi code for that object
steps: Open Python Usage, or expand + Load in Python under a widget
Read the generated code
Press Copy Script to put it on the clipboard
serves_tasks: Get a script that loads the whole file and lists its contents
Get a snippet that loads just the object being viewed
